summary: The revised story splits the depth audio pass into three leaves, each one focused behavior and one strict-subset changed subsystem (audio system): WI-06e-a finalizes per-band depth mixing (highCutoff roll-off, lowRumble, reverb) on the authored AUDIO_STOPS data seam in src/util/audio.ts with src/render/band.ts read-only; WI-06e-b adds creature sound profiles from the section 58 vocabulary plus per-band pre-visibility cue lead times tuned against final band visibility, with the ST-03 roster and trigger seams read-only; WI-06e-c adds sparse music tied to existing trigger flags with no 90-second loop and owns the final full AC-art-sound proof. The data-seam re-attribution to the audio system is documented in the story and applied consistently in all three leaves; the parent 'world content data' tag is retained as a scope-inventory tag, and each leaf's subsystem set remains a strict subset of the story's. All three children retain AC-art-sound verbatim (verified character-for-character) so their union covers the parent criterion, and WI-06e-c is explicitly named final proof owner and ordered after both siblings in depends_on. Dependencies are sound: the story and leaves a/b depend on the existing band passes WI-06a/b/c (needed for final visibility/attenuation and settled band identity, all verified present under ST-06); leaf c additionally depends on WI-06e-a/b for the cross-child proof; no cycles, no ancestor/descendant dependencies, and no existing node in the tree depends on WI-06e (grep-verified); the root plan already records the promotion and parallel ordering of a/b then c. The final proof is scoped to the depth-audio criterion (depth ladder, encounter lead time, music placement, master-volume seam) rather than a whole-game fix-all. Each leaf carries focused verification (Node data test plus one browser scenario, section 34 budgets, suite/build green) and a fresh-session handoff with exact file/symbol pointers plus the carried user constraints (procedural WebAudio, spoiler rules, master-volume seam intact). Ready for implementation; acceptance is of the plan, not of the feature.
